# copy-except-tar

Independent repository for the `copy-except-tar` workstation tool.

## Purpose

<!-- Generated by _code/_maintenance/generate-catalog.py; do not hand-edit. -->
Copy a directory excluding specified subfolder paths.


## Run

Run `./run.sh`, or use the optional shortcut under `desktop/`.

## Layout

<!-- Generated by _code/_maintenance/generate-catalog.py; do not hand-edit. -->
- `.gitignore`
- `desktop/copy-except-tar.desktop`
- `launchers/copy-except-tar.sh`
- `launchers/lib/terminal.sh`
- `python/copy-except-tar.py`
- `run.sh`

- `run.sh` is the stable entry point.
- `launchers/` contains the shell launcher.
- `python/` contains the program code.
- `lib/` or `launchers/lib/` contains private helper copies used only by this tool.
- `desktop/` contains KDE desktop integration.

Runtime environments, caches, locks, and generated state are intentionally excluded from Git.
